Name: Bog's Witchy Grass Variety
Author: BogWyytch
Description:
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/MTB50Stj/retro-bookcase-(9).png[/img]
Abagaianye and I are so proud to be the team leaders of Team Bog for the 2026 Modfest! Seeing so many mods being created in our Bogwood Valley Discord Server, I was inspired to make a highly requested custom blend of my grasses for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36458?tab=files]Grass Variety[/url]. 

This mod also replaces the textures of the Grass Starter and Blue Grass Starter item icons.

If you have other Grass Variety packs installed this mod IS COMPATABLE with those. Additionally, you will be able to purchase Bog specific grass starters in Piere's Shop if you have other packs. 

[center][u][size=5]CONFIG[/size][/u][/center]There are two config options available in this mod with GMCM
[list=1]
[*]Turn off retexture for Regular Grass Starter icon
[*]Turn off retexture for Blue Grass Starter icon
[/list][img]https://i.postimg.cc/G3kzHbHZ/retro-bookcase-(11).png[/img]
[u][size=5][center]ACCESSIBILITY[/center][/size][/u]

[u]Vision[/u]
   [u][i]Stardew Access[/i][/u]
[list]
[*]This mod has not yet been tested for compatibility with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16205]Stardew Access[/url].
[*]However, the only changes made to the game by this mod are visual - there are no other features.
[/list]
   [u][i]Trypophobia[/i][/u]
[list]
[*]This mod should be trypophobia safe.
[*]Please let us know if there are any sprites we do need to warn about.
[/list]
[u]Sound[/u]
[list]
[*]This mod contains no sounds of any kind.
[/list]
We welcome requests for any additional accessibility changes our players may need.

[u][size=5][center]COMPATIBILITY[/center]
[/size][/u]

[list]
[*]We do not currently provide compatibility for any recolour mods.
[*]However, this mod naturally pairs well with the colours in DaisyNiko's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]Earthy Recolour[/url]/[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14790]Interiors[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28948]Aimon's Witchy Dirt and Grass Recolor[/url].
[/list]

[u][size=5][center]UNINSTALLATION[/center]
[/size][/u]

[list]
[*]You can uninstall this mod at any time.
[*]Delete any mods that require it.
[*]Then delete this mod's folder.

[/list]
